notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
Standard MySQL client connection. Entry point for all MySQL enumeration and exploitation after credentials are obtained. The -p flag prompts for password interactively (avoids password in command history/process list).

=== KEY ENUMERATION ===
show databases; → list all databases
use database; → select database
show tables; → list tables
select * from users limit 10; → sample data
select User,Password from mysql.user; → credential harvest
select @@secure_file_priv; → file operation restriction check
